captions.detailed: A clip-on desk fan consisting of a light-gray, square main housing mounted onto a black C-clamp base. The back of the housing features horizontal ventilation slots and a small black rotary speed dial with a red indicator mark. The housing is supported on the clamp bracket via a vertical swivel neck, allowing it to rotate horizontally.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery script for a clip-on desk fan. It should feature a square light-gray housing with rear ventilation slots, a black rotary speed dial on the back, and a black mounting C-clamp base connected to the housing via a vertical swivel joint.
captions.factory: Construct the square fan housing by extruding a filleted rectangle and cutting horizontal slots on the rear face. Model the speed dial as a small cylinder with a red accent strip, positioned on the back of the housing. Create the mounting bracket by modeling a C-clamp shape using boolean operations on boxes and cylinders, then join it to the housing using a vertical cylindrical swivel pin.
